links.outcome: Physician and pharmacist review of real query-response pairs for correctness, completeness, helpfulness, and harm
links.effect: Of 633 queries, 614 evaluable; SMEs evaluated 426 pairs. Correctness 95.5%, comprehension 98.6%, helpful 94.4%, two responses (0.47%) scored as potential clinical harm; pairwise consensus 60.6%.
links.quote: Results demonstrated high rates of response correctness (95.5%) and query comprehension (98.6%), with 94.4% of responses rated as helpful.

links.outcome: Agreement among independent SME raters using mode and modified Delphi adjudication
links.effect: Pairwise consensus occurred in 60.6% of evaluations, with remaining cases requiring third tie-breaker review; consensus on harm classification was challenging.
links.quote: Pairwise consensus occurred in 60.6% of evaluations, with remaining cases requiring third tie-breaker review.

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and testing a reproducible 5-dimension evaluation framework with expert consensus protocols to validate a clinical generative AI system (ClinicalKey AI) before/during implementation.
